title: Promoted solubilization and desorption of petroleum hydrocarbons to remediate contaminated soils using Pickering emulsions stabilized by cellulose nanocrystals
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00920G, Paper
Yi Yang, Yi Ma, Tingting Huang, Xiaoming Song, Yinqing Zhang, Lingyan Zhu
HCOOH/H2SO4 hydrolysis was applied to prepare cellulose nanocrystals (FSCNCs), and Pickering emulsions stabilized by FSCNCs could effectively remove petroleum hydrocarbons from soil.
